create_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator: create a PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator instance for evaluating VOC-style AP on a given dataset name
run_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator_reset: reset the PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator predictions before processing new model outputs
run_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator_process: process model outputs with the evaluator by passing inputs and outputs to accumulate predictions
run_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator_evaluate: evaluate accumulated predictions and return AP, AP50, AP75 metrics for bounding boxes
run_voc_eval: run voc_eval to compute precision, recall, and AP for a given class using detection and annotation files
